title: LG to ban residential proxies from smart TV apps
summary: LG is implementing a ban on residential proxies for their smart TV apps to combat fraud and prevent users from bypassing geo-restrictions on streaming content. This move targets users who route their traffic through residential IP addresses to appear as legitimate home users rather than data center or VPN connections.
problem_solved: Prevents fraudulent activities like fake engagement metrics and circumvention of geographic content restrictions on LG smart TV platforms.
why_valuable: Protects content licensing agreements and ensures fair access to streaming services by blocking proxy-based circumvention of regional restrictions.
